hook: Dadi waves at the Junction — "Suno bachcho, hathi raja aaye!"
narration:
Suno bachcho, Junction par hathi raja!

हाथी राजा कहाँ चले। सुंदर सुंदर बेले लाले।

मेरे घर भी आते जाना। केले खाना दूध पीना।

Walking down the marigold lane. Trunk that sways just like a chain. Come on home for milk and bun. Hathi raja, join the fun.

Tuk-Tuk barks from the rooftop high. Pug-pug paws beneath blue sky. Jalebi smiles and Laddu waves. Dadi sings as the elephant plays.

हाथी राजा कहाँ चले। सुंदर सुंदर बेले लाले। Laddu, Jalebi, Tuk-Tuk sing। हाथी राजा our friend, our king।

Phir milenge agle station par!

suno_prompt.style: Cheerful upbeat children's nursery rhyme. WARM INDIAN FEMALE LEAD VOCALIST FLUENT IN HINDI, authentic desi accent on Hindi words, no English accent on Devanagari. Kids choir on chorus, gentle acoustic guitar + tabla, 120 BPM, warm Hinglish bilingual, picture-book joyful tone.

guest_characters.name: hathi_raja
guest_characters.description: Friendly chubby cartoon elephant in flat 2D Pingu/Peppa style: warm yellow-tan body, gold crown between big floppy ears, brick-red embroidered blanket on back, big round smiling eyes, no tusks (kid-safe). Walks with a gentle bounce; marigold garlands around the neck. Always drawn with thick black outlines and soft shading.
